prompts.L1:
Please polish the following text to make it more eloquent and professional, keeping all original information unchanged:

An apparatus for cutting slab material comprising a working table to support the slabs to be cut during working; a working unit comprising disk cutting means and water-jet cutting means; and a unit for moving the working unit above the working table. The movement unit comprises a horizontal translation unit to move the working unit along two directions parallel to the working table and perpendicular to each other; a vertical translation unit to move the working unit along a direction perpendicular to the working table; a first rotation unit to rotate the working unit about a first axis, vertical and substantially perpendicular to the working table; and a second rotation unit to rotate the working unit about a second axis, inclined with respect to the first axis. Said disk cutting means and water-jet cutting means are integral and therefore the second rotation unit rotates simultaneously with the said cutting means.

outputs.L1: An apparatus for cutting slab material comprises a working table configured to support the slabs during cutting; a working unit comprising disk-cutting means and water-jet-cutting means; and a movement unit configured to move the working unit above the working table. The movement unit comprises: a horizontal translation unit configured to move the working unit in two mutually perpendicular directions parallel to the working table; a vertical translation unit configured to move the working unit in a direction perpendicular to the working table; a first rotation unit configured to rotate the working unit about a first, vertical axis substantially perpendicular to the working table; and a second rotation unit configured to rotate the working unit about a second axis inclined relative to the first axis. The disk-cutting means and the water-jet-cutting means are integral with one another; therefore, the second rotation unit rotates both cutting means simultaneously.
outputs.L2: An apparatus for cutting slab materials includes a worktable that supports the slabs during cutting, a machining assembly equipped with both a cutting disk and a water-jet cutter, and a motion system configured to position the machining assembly above the worktable. The motion system includes a horizontal translation mechanism that moves the machining assembly in two mutually perpendicular directions parallel to the worktable, and a vertical translation mechanism that moves the assembly in a direction perpendicular to the worktable. It further includes a first rotary mechanism for turning the machining assembly around a first, substantially vertical axis perpendicular to the worktable, as well as a second rotary mechanism for turning the assembly around a second axis that is inclined relative to the first axis. The disk cutter and the water-jet cutter are rigidly connected, such that operation of the second rotary mechanism causes both cutting devices to rotate together.
outputs.L3:
The apparatus is designed for cutting slab material supported on a working table. It comprises a working unit in which disk-cutting means and water-jet cutting means are integrated, allowing either cutting method to be used as required.

A horizontal translation unit moves the working unit in two mutually perpendicular directions, both parallel to the working table. A vertical translation unit additionally moves the working unit in a direction perpendicular to the table.

The apparatus further includes two rotation units. These units rotate the integrated cutting means about a first, vertical axis and a second, inclined axis, respectively, thereby enabling the cutting means to be positioned and oriented for a range of cutting operations.
outputs.L4:
The apparatus is designed for cutting slabs of stone, ceramic, glass, composite material, or similar products. It includes a support table on which the slab is positioned and an integral cutting assembly arranged above the table. The cutting assembly combines a rotary disk cutter with a water-jet cutting head, allowing either cutting method to be selected according to the material, required contour, and desired surface finish.

The assembly is movable along three mutually perpendicular axes, enabling it to travel longitudinally and transversely across the slab and to move vertically toward or away from the support table. In addition, the cutting assembly can rotate about a substantially vertical axis and about an inclined axis. These rotational movements may be performed independently or simultaneously, so that the disk cutter and water jet can be oriented at a wide range of angles relative to the slab.

By coordinating the translational and rotational movements, the apparatus can produce straight, curved, oblique, beveled, and compound cuts with high precision. In particular, simultaneous rotation of the integral cutting assembly about the vertical and inclined axes permits continuous changes in cutting direction and inclination while machining is in progress. As a result, complex profiles can be formed without manually turning, repositioning, or reclamping the slab. This arrangement improves accuracy, reduces handling time, and increases the range of cutting operations that can be completed in a single setup.

counterfactuals.prompt: Draft a patent-style abstract for an apparatus that cuts slab material using integrated disk and water-jet cutting means mounted on a movable working unit.
counterfactuals.output: An apparatus for cutting slab material comprises a support structure defining a working area for receiving at least one slab and a movable working unit positionable relative to the slab along one or more controlled axes. The working unit carries both a rotary cutting disk and a water-jet cutting head, each selectively operable to perform respective cutting operations on the slab without transferring the slab between separate machines. An actuator system controls movement of the working unit and positioning of the cutting disk and water-jet cutting head relative to the slab. A control system coordinates movement and selectively activates either cutting means according to a programmed cutting path, thereby enabling straight, curved, through, and finishing cuts to be performed in a common working area with improved flexibility, accuracy, and processing efficiency.
counterfactuals.label: cf_1

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe a slab-cutting machine with a support table, horizontal and vertical translation mechanisms, and two rotational axes, emphasizing that the disk cutter and water jet rotate together.
counterfactuals.output: A slab-cutting machine comprises a support table for holding a slab and a cutting head movable relative to the table by horizontal and vertical translation mechanisms. The cutting head carries both a disk cutter and a water-jet nozzle. A first rotational axis adjusts the angular orientation of the cutting head, while a second rotational axis changes its inclination. The disk cutter and water-jet nozzle are mounted on a common rotating assembly so that they rotate together about both rotational axes, maintaining a fixed spatial relationship during cutting.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate technical patent language describing a CNC slab-processing apparatus whose integrated disk and water-jet tools are positioned above a worktable by translation and rotation units.
counterfactuals.output:
### Exemplary Patent Language

A computer numerically controlled slab-processing apparatus comprises a support frame defining a working region and a worktable configured to support a slab within the working region. A tool carriage is disposed above the worktable and is movably coupled to the support frame by a translation unit configured to position the tool carriage along at least one linear axis relative to the worktable.

The tool carriage supports an integrated machining head comprising a disk tool and a water-jet tool. The disk tool includes a rotatable spindle and a cutting or profiling disk coupled to the spindle. The water-jet tool includes a nozzle fluidly connectable to a source of pressurized cutting fluid and oriented to direct a cutting jet toward the slab. The machining head is coupled to the translation unit through a rotation unit configured to angularly position at least one of the disk tool and the water-jet tool about a rotational axis. The translation unit and the rotation unit are selectively operable to position and orient the disk tool or the water-jet tool at a commanded location above the worktable.

A numerical controller is operatively connected to the translation unit, the rotation unit, the spindle, and a water-jet pressure-control assembly. The numerical controller is programmed to execute a machining program defining tool paths for selectively processing the slab with the disk tool and the water-jet tool. The controller coordinates translational movement of the machining head, angular movement of the rotation unit, rotation of the disk tool, and discharge of the cutting jet to perform one or more cutting, trimming, profiling, grooving, drilling, or finishing operations.

### Exemplary Independent Claim

1. **A computer numerically controlled apparatus for processing a slab, the apparatus comprising:**

   a worktable configured to support the slab;

   a support structure extending over at least a portion of the worktable;

   a translation unit movably coupled to the support structure and configured to position a tool assembly relative to the worktable along at least one translational axis;

   a rotation unit carried by the translation unit and configured to rotate the tool assembly about at least one rotational axis;

   a disk tool supported by the tool assembly, the disk tool comprising a motor-driven spindle and a disk mounted for rotation by the spindle;

   a water-jet tool supported by the tool assembly, the water-jet tool comprising a nozzle configured to direct a pressurized fluid jet toward the slab; and

   a numerical controller operatively coupled to the translation unit, the rotation unit, the disk tool, and the water-jet tool,

   wherein the numerical controller is configured to coordinate operation of the translation unit and the rotation unit to position and orient the disk tool and the water-jet tool above the worktable and to selectively process the slab using the disk tool, the water-jet tool, or both.

### Exemplary Dependent Claims

2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the translation unit provides movement along mutually orthogonal first, second, and third linear axes.

3. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the rotation unit is configured to rotate the tool assembly about a substantially vertical axis.

4. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the rotation unit further comprises a tilting unit configured to pivot at least one of the disk tool and the water-jet tool about an axis transverse to a rotational axis of the disk.

5. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the disk tool and the water-jet tool are mounted to a common head body and have respective operating axes arranged at a predetermined angular or positional offset.

6. The apparatus of claim 5, wherein the numerical controller stores calibration data representing the positional offset between a cutting edge of the disk and an outlet of the nozzle.

7. The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a high-pressure pump fluidly coupled to the nozzle and a valve controlled by the numerical controller to selectively initiate and terminate the pressurized fluid jet.

8. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the worktable comprises a plurality of support members defining drainage passages for removal of cutting fluid and processing debris.

9. The apparatus of claim 1, further comprising a sensing system configured to determine at least one of a slab position, a slab thickness, a slab surface elevation, a disk-tool position, or a water-jet nozzle position.

10. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the numerical controller is configured to process a first portion of a programmed contour using the disk tool and a second portion of the programmed contour using the water-jet tool without repositioning the slab on the worktable.

11. The apparatus of claim 10, wherein the second portion comprises a corner, an internal contour, an aperture, or a region inaccessible to the disk because of a disk radius or an interference condition.

12. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the slab comprises stone, engineered stone, ceramic material, glass, concrete, or a composite panel.

13. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the rotation unit is configured to orient the disk in a plurality of vertical cutting planes relative to the worktable.

14. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the water-jet tool is independently movable relative to the disk tool between a deployed position and a retracted position.

15. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the numerical controller applies a coordinate transformation that compensates for rotation of the tool assembly and for an offset between respective working points of the disk tool and the water-jet tool.
counterfactuals.label: cf_5
